summary: A map reconciliation produces a reviewable claim before any model is asked, and every model-proposed tether passes the section 17 validator or lands in the job note instead

coordination.notes: A map_reconciliation job goes to awaiting_review even when the provider is absent or failing, because something real was produced - a claim a person can accept or reject. Reporting that as `failed` would hide finished work behind a missing model. A proposal that fails validation is recorded in the job note and never as a claim: a failed proposal is evidence about the model, not about the map, and storing it as a candidate would put an invented destination one Accept click away from the map. aiIngest.ts and aiWorkerHost.ts are outside the increment's touches list and were edited to give this a real caller - without the host constructing a ClaimStore and threading it through runHostTick, `deps.claims` would be a field nothing ever sets and the whole path would be dead in the app.
coordination.deviations: The authoritative-snapshot rule means a non-null destination is refused until something journals a `snapshot` event; today the journal carries `line` events, so in the running app every model-proposed destination is refused. That is the safe direction to be wrong in and is why the rule is a requirement on the evidence rather than on the proposal - it is recorded here rather than softened.
